dev and prod use one database. The extraction states the binding of each environment by the name of the database, and the read of each environment states the native ID, the account, and the name. All of it is one node. Then the extraction is read again and its file is given alone. The model keeps no environment of the node, so the records keep what each read said of it: the name in prod still fits the node, which the read of prod states in prod. No node is added and no mismatch appears.
